coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.notes: 1300 Fourth Street (Mission Bay South Block 6 East) -- 142 affordable apartments plus a manager's unit, developed by Tenderloin Neighborhood Development Corporation (TNDC), designed by Mithun Solomon and Studio VARA, ~$76M cost. Serves households up to 50% of Area Median Income, with 20% of units reserved for formerly homeless families; includes a mid-block mews with 12 townhomes and 10 flats over up to seven ground-floor commercial spaces fronting 4th St. Groundbreaking was reported late September 2016 with an expected ~2-year construction timeline (SocketSite); DataSF's Assessor tax roll lists blklot 8711505 as 'Multi-Family Residential' with no year_property_built recorded. Also referenced administratively as 626 Mission Bay Blvd for its separate ground-floor retail portion (blklot 8711506, not part of this parcel). DataSF's own Building Footprints layer only captures small fragments of this building's roof (a handful of sub-100 sq m slivers totaling well under the real footprint) rather than its full mass, confirmed visually against satellite imagery -- so this record uses the real Assessor parcel boundary (a single-building, single-parcel site) rather than the incomplete building-footprint layer, consistent with how every other real-parcel record here is drawn.
